title: Packaging Decision Record
description: D5 / S4-B1 decision record (#606). decision_key = sha256(canon_arr(package_id, revision_digest stripped, decision_scope)). decision_record_identity = sha256(canonical_object(record minus recorded_at minus outcome)); head, CAS and supersedes reference THIS identity. revision_digest and supersedes accept a single sha256: prefix on input (S4-B5) and are stored bare (P1-7).

decision_record_identity.description: sha256(canonical_object(record minus recorded_at minus outcome)); computed per contract 5.1, not stored.
